milestones.label: Discounted application fee closes
milestones.note: Applying after this costs more. Not a barrier, and a needless cost.

milestones.label: Normal closing date
milestones.note: The last day to apply at the normal fee, and the last day to apply at all for restricted courses such as medicine. A late window, 5 March to 1 May at €65, takes other courses only, and an institution may refuse a late application.

milestones.label: Change of Mind opens
milestones.note: Free, and it lets you rewrite the list entirely — which is why the 1 February deadline is less frightening than it looks. CAO Handbook 2027 gives 5 May at 12:00 as the "expected date".

milestones.label: Change of Mind closes
milestones.note: The last chance to change what you are applying for, five days before IB results. The list you hold on this date is the list that is scored.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After Change of Mind has closed. An IB applicant straight from school competes in Round One, with Irish school leavers.

milestones.label: Round 1 offers
milestones.note: Late August. The CAO Handbook 2027 lists Round One as "(TBC)"; in 2026 it was 26 August at 14:00. It follows the Irish Leaving Certificate results. Later rounds fill courses that remain open.

notes: Dates from the CAO Handbook 2027 (read 2026-09-24). Change of Mind opening is an "expected date" there and Round One is TBC; both stay provisional.
